files.rationale: Kept PR A's guid-first, Set-based Deduplicator with its constructor-taking-articles API (used by the merged Html2rss.collect_articles and the new spec) while folding in PR B's stripped/blank-aware key normalization with the id placed first in the id+URL fallback, retaining the `class ArticlePipeline` namespace and an optional `call(articles)` argument so the merged tree's class-based ArticlePipeline (which calls `Deduplicator.new.call(articles)`) still loads and works.
